author: Ashleigh Fields
description: North Korea on Sunday conducted a missile test for an upgraded solid-fuel engine it says can reach the U.S. mainland, according to state media.  The country reported the engine’s maximum thrust is 2,500 kilonewtons, noting an increase from a 1,970-kilonewtons test in September, according to the official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA).  The test took…
title: North Korea conducts test for missile it claims can target US mainland

author: Tara Suter
description: Rep. Yassamin Ansari (D-Ariz.), who is Iranian-American, said President Trump needs to find an off-ramp for the ongoing U.S. conflict with Iran soon. “’We’re already in this war, so what can be done?’ And I’ve been thinking a lot about that. Ultimately, I do think we need an off-ramp, quickly, to the war. We need…
title: Iranian-American lawmaker says Trump needs to find an off-ramp quickly for Iran war

author: Max Rego
description: Sen. Andy Kim (D-N.J.) said Sunday that the American people are paying the price of the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran on multiple fronts. “There’s a reason why Donald Trump is not coming before the American people for approval for this war,” Kim told host Jake Tapper on CNN’s “State of the Union.”  “It’s because he…
title: Americans ‘paying’ for Iran war with higher costs: Senate Democrat

author: Tara Suter
description: Sen. James Lankford (R-Okla.) on Sunday pushed for federal workers to be paid following recent tensions over funding for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in Congress. “We, by the way, I’ve got a bill that ends government shutdowns forever. You and I have talked about it before, this is a bipartisan bill, I believe…
title: Lankford: ‘We should never get to a moment we’re not paying federal workers’

author: Max Rego
description: White House border czar Tom Homan expressed uncertainty Sunday at whether federal immigration officers will leave airports once Transportation Security Administration (TSA) employees receive their delayed paychecks.  “We’ll see. It depends [on] how many TSA agents come back to work, how many TSA agents have actually quit and have no plans [on] coming back to…
title: Homan says ‘we’ll see’ if ICE officers leave airports once TSA workers get paid

author: Max Rego
description: Pope Leo XIV on Sunday said that God “does not listen to the prayers” of individuals who start wars, as the U.S.-Israeli conflict with Iran continues.  “Brothers and sisters, this is our God: Jesus, King of Peace, who rejects war, whom no one can use to justify war,” the first American pope, citing a Bible…
title: Pope Leo: God ‘does not listen to the prayers of those who wage war’

author: Max Rego
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told NBC News on Saturday that Russian forces took satellite images of a U.S. air base in Saudi Arabia three times in the days before Iran attacked the site.  During an interview in Doha, Qatar, Zelensky said he was “100 percent” confident that Russia was sharing that intelligence with Iran. On…
title: Russia took satellite images of US base in Saudi Arabia before Iran strike: Zelensky

author: Max Rego
description: The foreign ministers of Pakistan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Turkey will meet in Islamabad on Sunday, as the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran hits the 30-day mark.  Pakistan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs wrote Saturday on the social platform X that Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan arrived in Islamabad “along with Foreign Ministers of Saudi Arabia and…
title: Pakistan holds talks with Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Egypt on Iran war

author: Ellen Mitchell
description: During his briefing on the Iran war last week, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth suggested that Americans take a knee and pray to Jesus for the success of U.S. forces in the Middle East. A few days later, he read out a sermon praying that “wicked souls” be “delivered to the eternal damnation” in the fight…
title: Hegseth injects combative Christianity into America’s military

author: Filip Timotija
description: Iran’s firing of two missiles toward the joint U.S.-U.K. base in the Indian Ocean is putting Europe on notice that Tehran appears able to levy attacks previously considered beyond its reach.  In the March 20 incident, one intermediate-range ballistic missile fell into the water and the other was shot at. Still, while unsuccessful, it attests…
title: Iran puts Europe on notice with ‘game changer’ Diego Garcia missile incident
